The following defines a convenience function for loading libraries, installing if necessary.

```{r}
loadLibrary = function(packageName, suppressMessages = FALSE, githubRepo = NULL)
 {
  if (! require(packageName, character.only = TRUE)) {
    if (! is.null(githubRepo)) {
      loadLibrary("devtools")
      devtools::install_github(githubRepo)    
    }
    else 
      install.packages(packageName)
  
    if (suppressMessages)
      suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(packageName, character.only = TRUE))
    else 
      library(packageName, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}  
```

The main data frame of interest is the "trials" data-frame which contains one row per trial.

The data frame is modified to include a new column which encodes re-tweeting a tweet with other participants to be 1 and not re-tweeting to be 0.

```{r}

fd$trials
```

```{r}

priorCalc <- function(data,blockName) {
  # get the data columns relevant to the calculation
  temp <- data %>% select(uid, condition, groundTruth, percTruth) %>% group_by(uid, condition, groundTruth, percTruth) %>% summarize(n=n())

  temp <- temp %>% reshape2::dcast(uid + condition  ~ groundTruth + percTruth)
  temp[is.na(temp)] <- 0

  d <- temp %>% mutate(TRUE_real = TRUE_real   + .5,
         FALSE_fake = FALSE_fake + .5,
         FALSE_real   = FALSE_real   + .5,
         TRUE_fake = TRUE_fake +.5) %>% 
  mutate(hit_rate = (TRUE_real) / (TRUE_fake + TRUE_real),
         fa_rate  = (FALSE_real) / (FALSE_real + FALSE_fake),
         dprime   = qnorm(hit_rate) - qnorm(fa_rate),
         c        = -1 * (qnorm(hit_rate) + qnorm(fa_rate)) / 2 )
  colnames(d)[3:10] <- paste0(colnames(d)[3:10], blockName)
  return(d)
}
```

```{r}
shareCalc <- function(data,blockName) {
  # get the data columns relevant to the calculation
  temp <- data %>% select(uid, condition, groundTruth, shared) %>% group_by(uid, condition, groundTruth, shared) %>% summarize(n=n())

  temp <- temp %>% reshape2::dcast(uid + condition  ~ groundTruth + shared)
  temp[is.na(temp)] <- 0

  d <- temp %>% mutate(TRUE_Shared = TRUE_Shared   + .5,
         FALSE_notShared = FALSE_notShared + .5,
         FALSE_Shared   = FALSE_Shared   + .5,
         TRUE_notShared = TRUE_notShared +.5) %>% 
  mutate(hit_rate = (TRUE_Shared) / (TRUE_notShared + TRUE_Shared),
         fa_rate  = (FALSE_Shared) / (FALSE_Shared + FALSE_notShared),
         dprime   = qnorm(hit_rate) - qnorm(fa_rate),
         c        = -1 * (qnorm(hit_rate) + qnorm(fa_rate)) / 2 )
  colnames(d)[3:10] <- paste0(colnames(d)[3:10], blockName)
  return(d)
}
```

```{r}
rtwtCalc <- function(data,blockName) {
  # get the data columns relevant to the calculation
  temp <- data %>% select(uid, condition, groundTruth, retweetVal) %>% group_by(uid, condition, groundTruth, retweetVal) %>% summarize(n=n())

  temp <- temp %>% reshape2::dcast(uid + condition  ~ groundTruth + retweetVal)
  temp[is.na(temp)] <- 0

  d <- temp %>% mutate(TRUE_rt_yes = TRUE_rt_yes   + .5,
         FALSE_rt_no = FALSE_rt_no + .5,
         FALSE_rt_yes   = FALSE_rt_yes   + .5,
         TRUE_rt_no = TRUE_rt_no +.5) %>% 
  mutate(hit_rate = (TRUE_rt_yes) / (TRUE_rt_no + TRUE_rt_yes),
         fa_rate  = (FALSE_rt_yes) / (FALSE_rt_yes + FALSE_rt_no),
         dprime   = qnorm(hit_rate) - qnorm(fa_rate),
         c        = -1 * (qnorm(hit_rate) + qnorm(fa_rate)) / 2 )
  colnames(d)[3:10] <- paste0(colnames(d)[3:10], blockName)
  return(d)
}
```

```{r}
A_block <- data %>% filter(trialIndex %in% (0:9))
C_block <- data %>% filter(trialIndex %in% (40:49))
B_block <- data %>% filter(trialIndex %in% (10:39))

priorA <- priorCalc(A_block,'_prior_blockA')
priorC <- priorCalc(C_block,'_prior_blockC')

shareA <- shareCalc(A_block,'_share_blockA')
shareC <- shareCalc(C_block,'_share_blockC')

rtwtA <- rtwtCalc(A_block,'_rtwt_blockA')
rtwtC <- rtwtCalc(C_block,'_rtwt_blockC')
```


```{r}

```


```{r}

```

```{r}
dprime.anova <- aov( dprimePriorDiff ~ condition, final )
print(dprime.anova)
summary(dprime.anova)
```

```{r}

print(c.anova)
summary(c.anova)
```

```{r}

```

```{r}
cPriorDiffSummary <-final %>% group_by(condition) %>% summarise(n = n(),
                         mean = mean(cPriorDiff),
                         sd = sd(cPriorDiff),
                         se = sd/sqrt(n),
                         ci = se * qt((1-0.05)/2 + .5, n-1))

cPriorDiffSummary
```

```{r}
cPriorDiffSummary$condition[cPriorDiffSummary$condition == 'CTRL'] <- 'Control'
cPriorDiffSummary$condition[cPriorDiffSummary$condition == 'GRPN'] <- 'Critical'
cPriorDiffSummary$condition[cPriorDiffSummary$condition == 'GRPP'] <- 'Constructive'

#png("s1_c_prior_change.png", units="in", width=5, height=4, res=300)
ggplot(cPriorDiffSummary, aes(x=condition, y=mean)) + 
    geom_bar(position=position_dodge(), stat="identity", width = .5, fill="#41bbf0") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean-ci, ymax=mean+ci),
                  width=.2,                    # Width of the error bars
                  position=position_dodge(.5)) + 
   ylab("Criterion Change - Credibility") + xlab("Condition") + 
   theme_bw()
#dev.off()
```

```{r}
plotmeans( formula = cPriorDiff ~ condition, data = final,  xlab = "Condition Group", ylab = "C Difference", n.label = FALSE )
```
